message.subject: Outdoor graphics beyond the 3-year ceiling
message.body:
Hi [Name],

Congrats on the VorTex expansion—four new ReSource products is impressive momentum.

I'm reaching out because we're seeing more architectural and premium outdoor graphics specs requiring 10-15+ year performance, which creates challenges for standard outdoor substrates. We work with substrate manufacturers looking to move upmarket into these longer-lifespan applications.

Given your PRINTING United presence in October, would it make sense to discuss how protective film technology could differentiate your outdoor portfolio? Happy to share what we're seeing work for similar product lines.

Best,
[Your name]

personalization_used.hook: Recent VorTex Soft Signage expansion demonstrates active product innovation and market shift toward longer-lifespan outdoor applications
personalization_used.value_prop_emphasized: Enabling market expansion into premium outdoor segments requiring extended durability beyond current 1-3 year standard materials
